name: notes
description: The notes plugin: a local Markdown knowledge base wired into Claude Code, with automatic recall on every prompt and skills that capture decisions, facts, promises, events, and reminders.

plugins.name: notes
plugins.description: Surfaces unread reminders and relevant notes from your ~/.notes vault on every prompt, and adds skills that capture decisions, facts, events, promises, and reminders as drafts you confirm before they are saved. Requires the `notes` CLI from this repository and an initialized vault.
